claims.statement: The merge guide applies to FPT and GHEC, not GHES. It recommends one personal account for personal/professional repositories while GHEC distinguishes enterprise IdP-provisioned managed identities; this is not mandatory identity consolidation.

The sequence transfers repositories from the account intended for deletion to the retained account, including issues, pull requests and wikis, then verifies destination repository existence. Existence alone is weaker than complete parity, permissions, settings, package or recoverability evidence.
Local clone remote URLs must be updated after transfers. Working redirects cannot substitute for explicit current destination ownership and reference repair.

The sequence then deletes the unused account; separately reviewed deletion prerequisites, managed-user prohibition, irreversible effects and custody requirements remain applicable. Source sequence is not authorization for destructive action.

Past commit attribution may be associated by adding the author email to the retained account, but contribution criteria must also be satisfied. DOCS-PERSONALACCOUNTREF-8's noreply and nontransferable permissions/attribution exceptions must not disappear.

Account-types and job-change guides are further review pointers; no transfer, email addition, account merge or deletion is performed. This guide has no reusable includes and does not certify target completion.
